name: Pournami Eye, Dental & ENT Institute
description: A boutique specialty institute for eyes, teeth, ENT and facial aesthetics. Most treatments are day-care, so a one- or two-week trip is usually enough; digital smile design and 3D scans are done on the first visit.

procedure.name: Cataract Surgery (Phaco with Premium Lens, per eye)

inclusions: Doctor and procedure fees
Day-care bed / procedure room
Standard consumables and medicines on treatment days
Pre-operative eye scans and measurements
Post-operative eye-drops kit
Pre-procedure tests listed in the treatment plan
Review consultation before you fly home
exclusions: International airfare and visa fees
Treatment of unrelated or pre-existing conditions
Extended ICU stay or care for complications beyond the plan
Accommodation outside the hospital (see the Medical + Stay package)
Premium multifocal or toric lens upgrade if not chosen

reviews.title: Two implants in one trip
reviews.body: Had two dental implants placed last year. The 3D planning on day one meant I could fly home with temporary crowns after a week. Very professional team.
